title: Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Early Closure Fee: Measure by Position in the Minimum Term
content:
**Measure clause.** How the early closure fee of a Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service is measured depends on where the closure falls in the minimum term. When 3 or fewer whole months of the minimum term are left, the whole months left being the tier's minimum term less the whole months from the enrolled date to the closing date, the fee is measured as the tier's monthly platform fee for each of those whole months left. When fewer than 3 whole months have passed from the enrolled date to the closing date and more than 3 whole months are left, the fee is measured as the tier's early closure fee less every platform fee debited to the service since enrollment, net of any platform fee credited back, and never below zero. Any other early closure is measured at the tier's early closure fee. Throughout, whole months between two dates being the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's.

The platform fees debited since enrollment are every platform fee entry on the service's ledger; the platform fees credited back are every fee credit of a platform fee on that ledger.

## Measure by position in the term

| Position of the closure | Measured fee |
|---|---|
| 3 or fewer whole months of the term left | the monthly platform fee multiplied by the whole months left |
| fewer than 3 whole months passed and more than 3 whole months left | the early closure fee less the platform fees debited, net of platform fee credits, never below zero |
| any other position within the term | the early closure fee |

## Tier figures the measure reads

| Tier | Minimum term (months) | Early closure fee (USD) | Monthly platform fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Instant Pay Starter | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Core | 0 | 0.00 | 29.00 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Growth | 12 | 250.00 | 79.00 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Pro | 12 | 500.00 | 199.00 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Scale | 12 | 1000.00 | 499.00 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Enterprise | 24 | 2500.00 | 999.00 |

On a 12-month term, closures after 9, 10 or 11 whole months fall in the first row, after 0, 1 or 2 whole months in the second, and after 3 to 8 whole months in the third. On the 24-month Enterprise term the rows are 21 to 23, 0 to 2, and 3 to 20 whole months.

## Worked figures (hypothetical tier: 18-month term, early closure fee 400.00, monthly platform fee 60.00)

- After 16 whole months, 2 months are left: 60.00 for each, 120.00.
- After 15 whole months, 3 are left: 180.00.
- After 14 whole months, 4 are left and 14 have passed: 400.00.
- After 1 whole month, with platform fees of 75.00 debited and none credited: 400.00 less 75.00, 325.00.
- After 2 whole months, with 480.00 debited and 30.00 credited back: 400.00 less 450.00 is below zero, so 0.00.
